import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Mint {
        int x;
        Mint() { x = 0; }
        Mint(int sig) {
            int sigt = sig % MOD;
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        Mint(long sig) {
            int sigt = (int)(sig % MOD);
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        int get() { return x; }
        Mint add(Mint that) {
            int res = this.x + that.x;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new Mint(res);
        }
        Mint sub(Mint that) {
            int res = this.x - that.x;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new Mint(res);
        }
        Mint mul(Mint that) {
            long res = (long)this.x * that.x % MOD;
            return new Mint((int)res);
        }
        Mint addInPlace(Mint that) {
            this.x += that.x;
            if (this.x >= MOD) this.x -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        Mint subInPlace(Mint that) {
            this.x -= that.x;
            if (this.x < 0) this.x += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        Mint mulInPlace(Mint that) {
            this.x = (int)((long)this.x * that.x % MOD);
            return this;
        }
    }

    static class Matrix {
        Mint[][] v;
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            v = new Mint[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    v[i][j] = new Mint(0);
        }
        int height() { return v.length; }
        int width() { return v[0].length; }
        Mint at(int i, int j) { return v[i][j]; }
        void set(int i, int j, Mint val) { v[i][j] = val; }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix A = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                A.set(i, i, new Mint(1));
            return A;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = B.width(), p = B.height();
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    Mint sum = new Mint(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum = sum.add(at(i, k).mul(B.at(k, j)));
                    }
                    C.set(i, j, sum);
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix pow(long k) {
            Matrix A = this;
            Matrix B = identity(height());
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) != 0) B = B.multiply(A);
                A = A.multiply(A);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return B;
        }
    }

    static Matrix getRotateMatrix(int k, int t) {
        t = (t % k + k) % k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
            A.set(i, (i + t) % k, new Mint(1));
        A.set(k, k, new Mint(1));
        A.set(k+1, k+1, new Mint(1));
        A.set(k+2, k+2, new Mint(1));
        return A;
    }

    static Matrix getSingletonMatrix(int k, int j) {
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j)
                A.set(i, i, A.at(i, i).add(new Mint(1)));
        }
        A.set(k+1, k+1, new Mint(1));
        A.set(k+2, k+2, new Mint(1));

        A.set(k, k+1, A.at(k, k+1).add(new Mint(1)));
        A.set(j, k+1, A.at(j, k+1).sub(new Mint(1)));

        A.set(k, k, A.at(k, k).add(new Mint(2)));
        A.set(j, k, A.at(j, k).sub(new Mint(1)));

        A.set(k, j, A.at(k, j).add(new Mint(1)));
        return A;
    }

    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }

    static Matrix computeBlockMatrix(int k, int d) {
        if (d == 0) return getSingletonMatrix(k, 0);
        Matrix P = Matrix.identity(k + 3);
        Matrix Pprev = computeBlockMatrix(k, d-1);
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            P = P.multiply(Pprev);
            P = P.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, -1));
        }
        return P;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            int k = sc.nextInt();

            Matrix b = new Matrix(1, k + 3);
            b.set(0, k, new Mint(1));
            b.set(0, k+1, new Mint(1));
            b.set(0, k+2, new Mint(1));

            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                digits++;
            }

            long offset = 0;
            while (powk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / powk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    b = b.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, -s));
                    b = b.multiply(computeBlockMatrix(k, digits));
                    b = b.multiply(getRotateMatrix(k, s));
                    offset += powk;
                }
                powk /= k;
                digits--;
            }

            Mint ans = b.at(0, k+1);
            System.out.println(ans.get());
        }
    }
}
